app.name: QueryTool
app.tagline: Approved data queries without direct database access

sqlAssistantAccess._note: Who may use the ad-hoc SQL Assistant. Admins always may. Everyone else needs a group in allowGroups. Groups NOT listed (e.g. advisors) can only run pre-approved reports from the Queries page. Set adminOnly:true to restrict to admins, or list [] to deny all non-admins.

queryPolicy._note: A multi-table join is treated as HEAVY when it touches a mission-critical table (admins set these on the Data Governance page) OR when its estimated cost — the product of joined table sizes — exceeds heavyCostThreshold. Heavy queries are blocked during workHours (days: 1=Mon..5=Fri) and must be scheduled after hours. Set enabled:false to turn governance off.
